# Streamfog MCP

AI-driven AR lens orchestrator for live OBS streams. Control Streamfog face
filters, AR effects, and Vtuber avatars through MCP tools via the local
Streamer.bot WebSocket bridge.

- [Full documentation](llms-full.txt) - tools, endpoints, config, architecture
- [README](README.md) - quick start
- [Installation](INSTALL.md) - install guide
- [docs/TOOLS.md](docs/TOOLS.md) - tool reference
- [docs/CONFIGURATION.md](docs/CONFIGURATION.md) - configuration reference
- [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) - troubleshooting
- [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) - development guide
